title: Conditional expectile-based value-at-risk: Semiparametric estimation and inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.02716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional expectile-based value-at-risk (EVaR) has attracted increasing attention in financial risk management owing to its desirable theoretical properties. However, existing estimation methods for conditional EVaR either rely on potentially misspecified parametric models or suffer from the curse of dimensionality in nonparametric approaches. To this end, we study semiparametric estimation and inference for conditional EVaR in nonlinear time series models with unspecified error distribution. Specifically, we propose a two-step conditional EVaR estimator that achieves the parametric convergence rate. Furthermore, we derive a functional central limit theorem for conditional EVaR process, and then extend to investigate estimating both conditional expectile-based expected shortfall and conditional distribution. A residual bootstrap procedure is proposed for non-expert practitioners to conduct statistical inference. The asymptotic results

translated_title: 基于条件期望分位数的风险价值：半参数估计与推断
translated_abstract: 基于条件期望分位数的风险价值（EVaR）因其良好的理论性质，在金融风险管理中受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有的条件EVaR估计方法要么依赖于可能存在误设的参数模型，要么在非参数方法中受到维数灾难的困扰。为此，我们研究了误差分布未设定的非线性时间序列模型中条件EVaR的半参数估计与推断问题。具体而言，我们提出了一种两步条件EVaR估计量，该估计量达到了参数收敛速度。此外，我们推导了条件EVaR过程的函数中心极限定理，并进一步扩展研究了条件期望分位数型期望损失以及条件分布的估计。我们还提出了一种残差自助法程序，便于非专业实践者进行统计推断。渐近结果……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种两步半参数估计方法，用于估计误差分布未设定的非线性时间序列模型中的条件期望分位数型风险价值（EVaR），实现了参数收敛速度，并建立了函数中心极限定理与残差自助推断程序。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-step semiparametric estimator for conditional expectile-based value-at-risk (EVaR) in nonlinear time series models with unspecified error distribution, achieving parametric convergence rates, and establishes a functional central limit theorem along with a residual bootstrap procedure for statistical inference.
